entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The premier school of magic on the Orrithia continent of Arcavios, founded around 3861 AR by five elder dragons and divided into five colleges.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven is located; its birth involved overlapping mana from two planes.

entities.name: Orrithia
entities.description: The continent of Arcavios on which Strixhaven is located.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The five elder dragons of Arcavios, hatched from snarls of overlapping mana, who founded Strixhaven.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: One of the Founder Dragons, who had the idea of founding the institution that became Strixhaven and for whom a college is named.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: A Strixhaven college of passionate scholars and explorers devoted to adventure and discovery.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: A Strixhaven college of mages who use the elements for artistic self-expression.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: A Strixhaven college of mathematician wizards who treat math and magic as the same.

entities.name: Silverquill College
entities.description: A Strixhaven college specializing in verbal magic.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: A Strixhaven college of nature mages who either empower or exploit nature.

entities.name: Path Ward
entities.description: A committee established by Strixhaven to oversee the Omenpaths and vet visitors.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals that opened in 4562 AR, allowing off-plane students and professors to reach Arcavios.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: An elite force of mages who work with the Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Mage Tower
entities.description: Strixhaven's special sport in which college teams use magic to steal the opposing mascot.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The massive library anchoring Strixhaven's Central Campus.

entities.name: The Void
entities.description: An area enchanted with a modified silence spell, created accidentally during a duel and popular with students.

entities.name: Tolarian Academies
entities.description: A rival institution of magic to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Prism University
entities.description: A rival institution of magic to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Taiva
entities.description: University Director of Strixhaven, left traumatized by the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker listed as a Witherbloom professor teaching necromancy courses.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A junior professor who teaches courses on Arcavios history and the theory of Omenpaths.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker listed as a Strixhaven guest lecturer.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker listed as a Strixhaven advisor.

entities.name: Mavinda Sharpbeak
entities.description: A Silverquill professor who is also the Students' Advocate.

entities.name: Hofri Ghostforge
entities.description: A Lorehold professor.

entities.name: Augusta Tullus
entities.description: Interim dean of Lorehold College.

entities.name: Uvilda Mistcoiler
entities.description: Dean of Prismari College.

entities.name: Shaile Talonrook
entities.description: Dean of Silverquill College.

entities.name: Zaffai
entities.description: A Prismari professor and Grand Maestro of the Orchestra of the Arcane.

events.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, snarls of overlapping mana become luminous spheres from which five elder dragons hatch.
events.quote: Five particularly powerful snarls of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons .

events.summary: The dragons, once angry at mortals harnessing magic, realize disciplined study is needed; Prismari proposes an institution, which becomes Strixhaven.
events.quote: So, around 3861 AR , Prismari had the idea for the dragons to found an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

events.summary: The Founder Dragons withdraw from direct association with Strixhaven, letting the deans speak for them.
events.quote: They no longer associate directly with Strixhaven, preferring to let the deans of the college speak in their stead.

events.summary: The Omenpaths open in 4562 AR and the inaugural class of off-plane students arrives the next year with new professors.
events.quote: After the opening of the Omenpaths in 4562 AR , the inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed the following year

events.summary: Strixhaven establishes the Path Ward to oversee the Omenpaths and protect against exoplanar threats.
events.quote: the university established the Path Ward, a committee to oversee the Omenpaths.

events.summary: Students choose one of five colleges after their first year and are assigned two counselors with conflicting advice.
events.quote: Once a mage has chosen a college, they are assigned two counselors, one from each of the two mana colors of the college.

events.summary: College rivalries are played out in Mage Tower, a stadium sport of stealing the opposing mascot.
events.quote: the goal is to steal the opposing team's mascot and transport it over to their side.

events.summary: The Void is created accidentally during a duel and becomes a popular student spot.
events.quote: Created accidentally during a duel, it has become a popular spot for students to blow off steam.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion leaves University Director Taiva traumatized.
events.quote: The Phyreaxian Invasion left him traumatized.

relations.quote: Founded around 3861 AR by five elder dragons
Passionate scholars and explorers who dedicate their studies to adventure and discovery.
Mages who focus on the artistic side, using the elements to express themselves and their emotions.
They are mathematician wizards, seeing math and magic as the same concept.
They specialize in verbal magic, ranging from empowering poetry to biting arcane insults.
They are nature mages, on both sides of the spectrum, either empowering nature or exploiting it.
the university has generated an unofficial rivalry with the Tolarian Academies and Prism University
Strixhaven is a school of magic located on the Orrithia continent of the plane
